note: Small farm campground and horse camp on Ollie Rd, about 800 ft from Mammoth Cave National Park's Lincoln Trailhead. The stables sit close to the sites and horse campers tack up at them; campers without horses are welcome too. Sites 2-9 are pull-throughs on a loop drive. Glamping tents and cabins too. The Green River Ferry is the short way to the park's visitor center. --Claude
